summary: Jaguar Health, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026 regarding entry into a $40 million common stock purchase agreement (equity line of credit) with an institutional investor on June 9, 2026. The company has the right, but not the obligation, to direct the investor to purchase shares under fixed and VWAP purchase mechanisms, subject to a floor price of $1.10 per share and maximum single purchase of $1.5 million. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or terms typical of a special-situation event are present.
